description: Cross-target attack patterns shared across engagements

patterns.name: Login bypass via JS bundle analysis
patterns.applicability: SPAs with client-side routing and API backends
patterns.evidence_needed: READ on JS file containing hardcoded credentials or API keys

patterns.name: SSRF to cloud metadata
patterns.evidence_needed: Canary oracle on SSRF, READ on metadata response

patterns.name: File upload to RCE
patterns.applicability: Applications with file upload and web-accessible upload directory
patterns.evidence_needed: Canary oracle on file write, READ on webshell execution

patterns.name: IDOR to account takeover
patterns.applicability: APIs with predictable resource IDs and password reset flows
patterns.evidence_needed: Fuzz oracle on IDOR, canary on token extraction

patterns.name: Deserialization to RCE
patterns.evidence_needed: Parser_diff oracle on deserialization, canary on command execution
